name: GB energy supply margins
value: No notice in force; winter margin 9.5%
summary: NESO forecasts a 5.9 GW, 9.5% winter buffer; no Electricity Margin or Gas Margins Notice found in force as of 15 Nov
state: NESO's Winter Outlook, revised on 27 Oct, forecasts a 5.9 GW surplus, a 9.5% buffer over peak demand (NESO; Solar Power Portal). Searches on 15 Nov found no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice in force, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: NESO says routine margin notices on cold, still days are a normal part of running the grid and do not by themselves signal a risk to household supplies.
rubric_hit: Normal: no NESO margin or National Gas notice in force; winter buffer 5.9 GW (9.5%)
basis_detail: NESO and National Gas system notices
basis_by: NESO and National Gas system notices

sources.title: Solar Power Portal — GB to have 9.5% buffer over peak demand this winter, NESO says

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
